title: Ajisai Host Protocol
description: The value wire format shared by every host surface, rendered by the single serializer rust/src/types/value_protocol.rs::value_to_protocol (its own doc comment: 'the single source of truth for the value wire format (WASM and CLI)'). Both the CLI/MCP agent surface (the `stack` array inside `ajisai agent compute|check|infer-contracts --json`; the enclosing envelope is documented informally in docs/dev/agent-cli-output-contract.md, non-canonical) and the WASM/GUI boundary (each of AjisaiInterpreter's collect_stack/execute/... methods, with no enclosing envelope of its own) emit arrays of the observedValue node this schema defines. There is no protocol-version field on this shape today: the CLI envelope around it carries a plain integer `schemaVersion`; the WASM boundary carries no version signal at all. `additionalProperties: false` is used only where every field has been confirmed exhaustively against the current Rust source (the node's own three keys); `semantics`, and every string-valued field it carries, is deliberately left open (no enum, no additionalProperties restriction) because those vocabularies are large, still evolving, and owned by the Rust source below, not duplicated here as a second, narrower list (the cause of a previous, now-corrected drift: see spec/language-semantics.md LANG.OBSERVATION.PROTOCOL).

observedValue.description: One stack value as observed at the host boundary. Every field is derived from the value itself, never from the Word that produced it (LANG.VALUES.DENOTATION). A vector's own elements are observedValue nodes in turn (see `value` below), so this definition is recursive.

type.description: The value's domain (LANG.VALUES.DISJOINT), discriminating `value`'s shape. A NIL is `nil` wherever it stands, including in truth position, where it reads as UNKNOWN (LANG.VALUES.TRUTH).

value.description: Shape depends on `type`: nil -> null; boolean -> boolean; number -> {numerator, denominator} (arbitrary-precision decimal strings); string or symbol -> string (a symbol's bare name); vector -> an array of observedValue; record -> {keys, values}, two arrays of observedValue of equal length, aligned position by position (LANG.RECORDS.STRUCTURE).

semantics.description: Present on every node except an interior (rank >= 2) tensor node. Every field below is optional within it. Both host surfaces emit the same set (rust/src/wasm_interpreter_bindings/wasm_value_conversion.rs::value_semantics_to_js for WASM/GUI, rust/src/agent/report.rs::semantics_json for CLI/agent) — the retired HostProtocolV1 additionally spelled semanticKind/shape/capabilities/origin here, but the seven value domains already discriminate themselves through `type`, so no reader ever needed a second axis for it.

truthValue.description: Present on a Boolean node, and only there (rust/src/types/value_absence.rs::truth_value). UNKNOWN is a NIL (LANG.VALUES.TRUTH) and is observed through `absence`, not here.

absence.description: Present only on a nil-type node. `reason` is the stable, machine-readable identifier LANG.VALUES.NIL calls the entire observable content of a NIL (LANG.CONTRACT.REGISTRY's projection.reason values, plus the wider AbsenceOrigin/NilReason vocabulary an error path can also produce); it is absent only for a NIL an implementation could not yet label. `origin` and `recoverability` are diagnostic state beyond the reason, informational only. `diagnosis`, present only on the CLI/agent surface, nests the fuller structured diagnosis object docs/dev/agent-cli-output-contract.md describes.

approximate.description: true when the node is an irrational scalar (LANG.VALUES.EXACT), whose `value` is therefore a best rational approximation. Never present otherwise.

exactTerms.description: An ExactScalar's exact multiquadratic normal form, structured for computation: one term per {numerator, denominator, radicand}. The stack display writes the same terms as one token (`sqrt(2)`, `1/1+sqrt(2)`).
